_comment: The vocabulary a user never reads. One source of truth: the Stop hook
reads it rather than keeping its own copy -- a second list is a list
that drifts, and every rule added to one and not the other reads as
Each entry maps a pattern to what the user should read instead.

case_insensitive.\\bharvest(?:ed|ing)?\\b: your notebook already tested this -- I'll reuse its numbers
case_insensitive.\\bgolden value(?:s)?\\b: checked it still gives your notebook's answers
case_insensitive.\\bfilter_defaults\\b|\\blink identifier: which spectrum the plot opens on
case_insensitive.\\bWorkflowManager\\b|\\bpython tool\\b|: (internal -- name the page or the analysis)
case_insensitive.\\bmateriality threshold\\b|\\beffect si: how much it moves the result
case_insensitive.\\bpreflight\\b: (say nothing, or: setting up -- a minute)

case_sensitive.\\bHARDCODE\\b|\\bADVANCED\\b|\\bDASHBOA: keep it / hide it / put it on the results page
